authors: Yong Qiu, Hongquan Chen, Zhiyong Sheng, Suzhen Cheng
definition: Governance = 'all of the mechanisms within a project organization that... determine how resources are used and distributed... and resolve conflicts' (p. 427).
stakeholders: Four governments + designers/contractors/public; 'system leaders... conflicting buffer' (p. 435).
temporality_detail: Moderate, project-internal. 'evolutionary complexity... dynamic during their entire life cycle' (p. 425).
gaps: Multi-government structure but no electoral turnover modelled.
key_quotes: Governance = 'all of the mechanisms within a project organization that... determine how resources are used and distributed... and resolve conflicts' (p. 427).
'evolutionary complexity... dynamic during their entire life cycle' (p. 425).
coding_notes: Six-complexity typology parallels Esposito & Terlizzi (2023); cited by Pathak (2023).
